sections.heading: Goal
paragraphs: Make implementation plans easy to scan and review in Google Docs.

sections.heading: Scope and non-goals

paragraphs.text: Generate native title, heading, paragraph, link, and list formatting.
Preserve the existing review-status dropdown and approval gates.

paragraphs: Do not change application behavior or the review-status workflow.

sections.heading: Current behavior
paragraphs: The planning template inserts plain text and a review-status dropdown. Formatting and content offsets must stay aligned.

sections.heading: Proposed approach
paragraphs: Use `build_plan.py` to turn structured content into a Google Docs batch request. Compute ranges from rendered text using UTF-16 offsets, then insert the unchanged status chip last.

paragraphs.text: Add the standard-library generator and strict input validation.
Add offline tests and document the generation command.

sections.heading: Verification
paragraphs: Run `python3 -m unittest discover -s .opencode/skills/planning/tests -v`. Expect all offline tests to pass; this is a planned check, not a recorded result.
Review a generated document for readable headings, native lists, clickable links, and the unchanged dropdown.

paragraphs.text: Google Docs ranges use UTF-16 code units. Non-BMP characters and chip insertion order need explicit regression coverage.
Rendered text contains no inline Markdown markers.
Lists, links, headings, and the existing status options remain usable.
Changing plan length never requires hand-editing offsets.
